modes.rounded: 100-digit sum of exported rounded production edge fluxes and source products; isolates summation/norm rounding.
modes.kernel: Exact binary G/psi/n/p Poisson operands and exported SG/SRH kernel operands, fixed double material/geometry coefficients.
modes.split: Exact x times potential scale, retained qf reference plus increment, recomputed densities and SG/SRH in high precision at actual rounded candidate x.
modes.ideal: As split, but x=base_x+alpha*capped_step formed without double rounding; diagnostic mathematical trial, not a representable production iterate.

decisions: Use each representation own baseline merit. Reproduce actual norm and global-mode formula; norm<base or norm<=(1-1e-4*alpha)*base. Never accept a state from a diagnostic scan.
scope: All Poisson rows and both free Si carrier rows; exact binary operands, all source and boundary/gauge rows retained. Linear defect uses exported full Jacobian and raw/capped directions.
